status_definitions.IMPLEMENTED_VERIFIED: The section's reusable mechanism is present and has current, inspectable verification. It is not a claim of professional generalization.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Some relevant mechanism or evidence exists, but the directive's full behavioral requirement remains unproven.
status_definitions.EXTERNAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Further progress depends on an explicit human or external review rather than an agent assumption.
status_definitions.DEFERRED_BY_PRIORITY: The work is intentionally postponed by the live priority rule and is not represented as complete.

requirements.title: Professional modeling judgment
requirements.current_boundary: The C38 model run and its human_stage_review.json evidence were deliberately deleted 2026-08-17 (direct user instruction: every named-product model-build attempt to date was judged not good enough to keep). A subsequent magnifying-glass build was purged 2026-08-20 for repeated overclaiming. The mallet and mug-handle-join builds (2026-08-20) are the first in this project's history to receive and pass an actual human-authored visual review record (REVIEW_ACCEPTED_NO_REPAIR via tools/record_external_visual_review.py) rather than only self-assessment or a recorded rejection; the mug-handle-join build specifically re-tests the authored two-part join skill that broke the magnifying glass. Both deliberately used known/authored forms, not an unfamiliar reference, so broad professional generalization to an unseen target remains unproven.
requirements.next_step: Apply the learned construction rules -- including the now-demonstrated authored-bridge join -- to a genuine unfamiliar reference target and again seek independent human visual review.

requirements.title: Reference modeling and perception
requirements.current_boundary: Reference-set gating, calibrated image alignment, and controlled review views exist. Independent observation records can now confirm or contradict numeric/boolean consequences for competing representations without letting candidates embed their own proof. The AA/LR6 run uses side and top evidence to reject a stacked-terminal interpretation and drive one connected typed blockout with exact evaluated dimensions. This remains a simple rotational primary form without human acceptance; it does not prove difficult multi-view interpretation.
requirements.next_step: Use the same non-circular competing-hypothesis path on a fresh non-rotational manufactured target with ambiguous depth or component continuity, then revise the interpretation from Blender render evidence.

requirements.title: Research and knowledge lifecycle
requirements.current_boundary: Source observation, bounded episode review, two-family UV transfer, principal-axis Image Empty transfer, and two-family explicit bevel-intent transfer exist. Since 2026-08-17, two more techniques (bevel-segment parity, inset-before-extrude containment) were each taken all the way through reproduce -> transfer -> visual+technical verify -> retrieval -> planner use -> RUNTIME_VALIDATED, both surfacing and correcting a real overreach in their source's claim rather than promoting it as stated. Real-asset runtime use (an actual unfamiliar reference, not a synthetic ticket built to test the wiring) remains the open gap for both.
requirements.next_step: Apply a validated skill during an authorized real-reference modeling task and record whether retrieval actually changed the resulting decision and improved the model, not just whether the typed transaction executed.

requirements.title: Controlled experiments and retrieval
requirements.current_boundary: CORRECTED 2026-08-19 by audit. The previously recorded runtime validations for three skills were circular: each test hand-authored a ticket whose type string was copied from the skill's own planner_hint trigger list and whose operation_params carried the fix, so the planner only performed a dictionary lookup and knowledge contributed nothing to the mutation. Two of those RUNTIME_VALIDATED statuses are withdrawn to TRANSFER_VALIDATED. One skill (bevel-segment parity) now has genuine non-circular evidence: knowledge_engine/defect_classifier.py emits a structurally-decidable `corner_triangle` ticket from real base-cage topology, the planner supplies the even-segment parameter from knowledge rather than from the ticket, and the loop gates commit-vs-rollback at verify time. Testing that loop also FALSIFIED a claim in the knowledge base (re-beveling to remove a corner triangle makes the cage strictly worse), which is now recorded as such. A fail-closed test (tests/test_skill_trigger_vocabulary.py) prevents the circularity recurring silently.
requirements.next_step: Fire a validated skill during an actual reference-driven build. No skill has yet influenced a model made from an unfamiliar reference, because no such build currently exists in the repo.
